# Project Instructions

Before generating or editing any curriculum, slide, assessment, or script:
1. Read `docs/ssot/Core_Values_and_Pedagogical_Standards.md` and strictly follow its anti-hallucination, 4-part chapter structure, algebra-first math, visual-first slide, FERPA, and copyright rules.
2. Read `docs/ssot/Academic_Development_Master_Summary.md` for current SSOT folder paths, chapter status, and completed demo benchmarks.
3. If task-specific skills exist in `.copilot/skills/` or `.github/skills/`, load the relevant skill before executing.
4. Keep responses concise and scoped strictly to the requested feature. Do not invent FRED codes, statistics, or citations—ask for confirmation if any parameter is missing.
